name: Shimabara Castle
description: Shimabara Castle was built 1618-1624 by Matsukura Shigemasa, whose oppression sparked the Shimabara Rebellion (1637-38) — the last great Christian uprising. The 1964-reconstructed five-story keep now houses a museum; the castle town is ringed by stone walls and samurai lanes.
notes: Keep admission ¥520; the Samurai Street and the Christian heritage sites are within walking distance.

ja.name: 島原城
ja.description: 1618〜1624年、松倉重政が築いた島原城。キリシタン弾圧から島原の乱へと繋がる歴史を伝える五重天守が再建されています。
highlights: 城下町の石垣と武家屋敷
ja.notes: 天守は大人520円。武家屋敷やキリシタン史跡と合わせてどうぞ。
